scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && npm run build -w web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && npm run dev -w web
scripts.emulators: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:start --import=./.emulator-data --export-on-exit
scripts.test:unit: npm run build -w shared && npm run test:unit -w verify
scripts.test:functions: npm run build -w shared && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,storage "npm run test:functions -w verify"
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions "npm run test:e2e -w verify"
scripts.verify: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec "npm run verify -w verify"
scripts.test:load: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w functions && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions "npm run test:load -w verify"
